ไทยมีรถตุ๊กตุ๊ก
เวียดนามมี xe ba gac (แซ บา กั๋ก)
ฉันหวังว่าฉันจะยังสามารถซื้อหรือเป็นเจ้าของรถตุ๊กตุ๊กสักคันเพื่อนำมาจัดแสดงในบ้านที่ตกแต่งสไตล์ไทยของฉันได้

items.text_vn:
Mình rất mong đến ngày hai chiếc xe này được bán. Thái có xe tuk-tuk, Việt Nam có xe ba gác. Mình hy vọng vẫn mua được một chiếc tuk-tuk để trưng bày trong ngôi nhà trang trí kiểu Thái của mình.
Lưu ý: mình không chắc chính tả hay ngữ pháp có đúng không vì mình dùng Google Dịch để sửa lỗi.
items.text_en:
I can't wait for these two vehicles to go on sale. Thailand has the tuk-tuk, Vietnam has the xe ba gac. I hope I can still buy a tuk-tuk to display in my Thai-style decorated house.
Note: I'm not sure my spelling or grammar is right because I used Google Translate to fix mistakes.
